(a) cylindrical gauge field configurations are a signal of confinement in nonabelian gauge theory, and (b) the infrared approximation to the Yang-Mills field equations of QED is not a signal of confinement.

(1) the infrared approximation to QCD generates a mapping of QCD configuration space into two-dimensional configuration space, (2) this mapping is not unique, (3) the mapping is not trivial, (4) the mapping has the feature that the two-dimensional theory is abelian if and only if QCD is abelian.

(i) the gauge fields of QCD are confined to a two dimensional space, (ii) this space is generated by an approximate mapping of configuration space to a cylinder, and (iii) the resulting cylindrical gauge field configurations are responsible for the confinement of quarks.
